snippet.title: SUPER RAIDEN (SUPER雷電). [PC Engine Super CD]. 1CC. No Death. 60Fps.
snippet.description:
SUPER RAIDEN (SUPER雷電). [PC Engine Super CD]. 1CC. No Death. 60Fps.
:- Played By PiE. - "September 2nd, 2020".
.
Wiki. - "a 1990 vertically scrolling shooter arcade video game developed by Seibu Kaihatsu and published by Tecmo in Japan. The game's story takes place in the year 2090, when an alien species known as the Crystals invaded Earth. Players assume the roles of the Vanquish Crystal Defense pilot duo, taking control of two state of the art Fighting Thunders aircraft to defeat the Crystals and save the Earth."
.
